descriptions.description: Tolpis is a genus of flowering plants in the tribe Cichorieae within the family Asteraceae.Adanson, Michel. 1763. Familles des Plantes 2: 112, 612. in FrenchTropicos, Tolpis Adans. It is native to Africa, Southern Europe, the Middle East and Macaronesia. Many species are limited to the Canary Islands.Crawford, D. J. (2010). Mixed mating in the ‘obligately outcrossing’ Tolpis (Asteraceae) of the Canary Islands.
